wrong.why: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, and she bore Attai, so Attai is Sheshan's grandson through the daughter, not his son.
Haran begat Gazez, so this Gazez is Haran's son and Caleb's grandson; the chapter names Haran between him and Caleb.
